Here's how to set up re-figma M C P in Claude Desktop, on Windows.
First, open PowerShell, and install Node.js and Python with winget. Then open a new PowerShell, and check the versions: Node must be twenty-two point fifteen or newer.
In Claude Desktop, open Settings, then Developer, and click Edit Config.
This opens claude desktop config dot json. Right after the first curly brace, add the M C P servers block, and keep everything else as it is.
On Windows, the command is cmd, with slash c, then npx. Starting npx directly fails. Save with Control S.
Now quit Claude completely, from the tray icon, and open it again. Closing the window is not enough.
Once it is back, open Settings, then Developer. Re-figma M C P should show Running. If it doesn't, click View logs to see why.
In a new chat, open plus, then Connectors. Re-figma M C P is listed, and switched on.
Paste a link to a Figma frame, and ask Claude to read it.
The first time, Claude runs figma relogin, and an Edge window opens. Sign in to Figma there, within five minutes. After that, everything runs in the background.
Claude gets the layout tree, and can turn the frame into code.
New versions install themselves. Just quit and reopen Claude. Ask for figma status to see which version is running.
